title: Oscillation of Second-Order Hybrid Neutral Delay Difference Equations Using Binomial Form
content: This paper explores the oscillatory behavior of a class of second-order hybrid-type neutral delay difference equations. A novel approach involves transforming these complex trinomial equations into a simpler binomial form, using solutions from an associated linear difference equation. By employing comparison techniques and summation averaging methods, we establish new oscillation criteria that ensure all solutions exhibit oscillatory behavior. Our findings extend current oscillation theory and are applicable even to non-neutral second-order equations. Couple of examples are provided to demonstrate the significance and originality of these results.
